channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: Start here.
channels.message:
**Welcome to Rust Legacy Browser**
Rust Legacy, rebuilt to run in your web browser.

**1.** Read {#rules}
**2.** Verify in {#verify} to unlock the server
**3.** Pick your pings and region in {#get-roles}

Then: news in {#announcements} and {#updates}, chat in {#general}, questions in {#help} and {#faq}, bugs in {#bug-reports}.

New members appear below as they join.

channels.name: rules
channels.topic: Read these before you post.
channels.message:
**Rules**
1. Be decent. No harassment, hate speech or slurs.
2. No cheating, cheat selling or sharing exploits. Report cheaters in {#open-a-ticket}, not in public.
3. No sharing game files, extracted assets or links to them.
4. No spam or advertising, and no invite links to other servers.
5. Use the right channel: bugs in {#bug-reports}, ideas in {#suggestions}, questions in {#help}.
6. Keep it SFW.
7. Moderators have the final say. Appeals go through {#open-a-ticket}. Using an alt account to dodge a ban gets every account banned.

Rust Legacy Browser is a fan project. Not affiliated with Facepunch Studios.

channels.name: verify
channels.topic: Verify here to unlock the server.
channels.message:
**Verify to get in**
Press **Verify** on the panel below and solve the captcha. You'll get the **Member** role and the rest of the server opens up.

Stuck? Send a direct message to a Moderator.

channels.name: faq
channels.topic: Common questions.
messages:
**FAQ**

**What is Rust Legacy Browser?**
A fan-made port of Rust Legacy, the original version of Rust, that runs in your web browser. No download, launcher or extension.

**What do I need to play?**
A desktop or laptop with a keyboard and mouse, and a browser with WebGL 2 (a current Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari). Phones can browse the website, register and read the wiki, but can't play.

**How do I start?**
Make an account on the website (email, Steam or Discord), open **Servers**, pick one and press **Join**. The website's **How to play** page covers the controls and your first night.

**Is this official?**
No. It's a fan project, not affiliated with Facepunch Studios.

**Can I bring my desktop character?**
On servers that support it, you can link your desktop Rust Legacy character from the server's page on the website once you're signed in. It's optional.

**When do servers wipe?**
Each server's page on the website shows its last wipe. Planned wipes go in {#wipe-schedule}.

**Found a bug or have an idea?**
Post it in {#bug-reports} or {#suggestions}, one per post.

**Someone is cheating.**
Open a ticket in {#open-a-ticket} with a clip or screenshot. Don't name them in public channels.

**How do levels work?**
Chatting earns XP. Level roles come at 5, 10, 20, 35 and 50, each with its own name colour. See {#level-ups}.

**Why are names different colours?**
Staff and special roles show their colour first, then Server Booster pink, then your level colour.

**I want to run a server.**
The website has server owner tools in your account menu. Once your server is verified you get the **Server Owner** role and the owners' channels.

**Levels**
Chatting earns XP; spamming doesn't earn any extra. Level-ups are announced here.

**Lv 5** Survivor
**Lv 10** Builder
**Lv 20** Raider
**Lv 35** Veteran

Each level role colours your name and replaces the one before.

**How to report**
One message per issue: build or date, browser and version, what you did, what you expected and what happened. Add a clip or screenshot if you can. Confirmed bugs move to {#bug-reports}.

channels.name: staff-chat
channels.topic: All staff: admins, moderators, developers and wiki editors.
channels.message:
**Staff guide**
• {#staff-chat}: all staff
• {#mod-chat}: moderators and admins (reports, bans, appeals)
• {#admin-chat}: admins only; Discord's own notices land here
• {#mod-log}: AutoMod alerts, message logs and ticket transcripts
• {#wiki-staff}: wiki planning
• {#dev-log}: commits, builds and deploys

Everyone on staff also needs the **Member** role. Handle player problems in tickets rather than DMs, so there's a record.

channels.name: mod-chat
channels.topic: Moderators and admins: reports, bans, appeals.
channels.message:
**Moderation guide**
**Ladder** (skip steps for serious cases):
1. Warn in the channel or by DM
2. Timeout for 10 minutes
3. Timeout for 1 day
4. Kick
5. Ban: admins only, so post the case here

**Ban straight away:** cheat sellers, doxxing, NSFW, raids, and alt accounts dodging a ban.

**Cheater reports** come in through tickets. Ask for a clip or screenshot, and never accuse anyone in public.

**Give every action a reason**, so the audit log and {#mod-log} make sense later. If you're part of an argument, let another moderator handle it.

checklist: Server Settings → Safety Setup: require 2FA for moderator actions (only the owner can switch this on).
Give yourself and every staff member, tester and server owner the Member role too. Staff roles only add access on top of Member.

After adding a bot, run this script again: it gives the bot the Bots role (or it can't see the members-only channels) and moves its role above Member and the level roles, because a bot can only hand out roles below its own.

Wick (verification): add the setup bot to Wick's whitelist first, or its anti-nuke may punish the script. Run w!setup (it creates Quarantine), then w!statics @Member ?add 5 (the role Wick gives when someone passes), w!verification 1 ?on, w!v all ?set 3, w!v captcha ?set 6 and w!s #verify ?set 12. Not Double Counter: it was breached in October 2026 and Discord blocked new installs.

Arcane (levels): send level-up messages to #level-ups and add role rewards Survivor (Lv 5) at level 5, Builder (Lv 10) at 10, Raider (Lv 20) at 20, Veteran (Lv 35) at 35 and Legend (Lv 50) at 50, with the previous reward removed.
Carl-bot (self roles): in #get-roles, one menu for Patch Notes / Wipe Alerts / Events and one for EU / NA / OCE / ASIA (unique: one at a time).
After your first boost Discord creates the Server Booster role. Run this script again then to colour it pink and list boosters separately.
Add a ticket bot (for example Ticket Tool) to #open-a-ticket for cheater reports, ban appeals and account help.
Delete the default categories and channels listed above if you don't want them.
Take Administrator away from the setup bot, or kick it.
